### 문서
- `SKILL.md` — Proves which files in a dirty working tree are pure formatter noise before committing: re-run the formatter on the HEAD version and compare with the working copy — the only no-op proof. Use when a diff's size contradicts the known work, or before committing a tree where a formatter may have run (inherited session, long-running branch).
